**Synopsis:**
A major pattern shift is underway across western Europe, ending a prolonged summer heatwave. A cold front moving in from the Atlantic will bring temperatures 3°C below seasonal norms in parts of the UK by Thursday, with >15°C temperature drop vs. the prior week. Southern England has seen 62 consecutive dry days. Significant rainfall and thundery showers are expected mid-week into the weekend. The cold front pushes into France and Germany by Wednesday. Meanwhile, the southern US remains under extreme heat warnings, with apparent overnight temperatures of 31–33°C and daytime heat index potentially exceeding 46°C.
